name: enrich-contact-records
description: Enrich Notion contact records with a work email and profile signals. HarvestAPI first when the contact has a LinkedIn URL: a synchronous find_profile lookup by that URL returns name, title, about (Bio), city, country and an SMTP-checked address (written only when deliverable + valid). Apollo people/match (sdk.fetch through an API by Zapier connection) is the fallback when HarvestAPI is not tried, finds nothing, errors, or finds the profile but no deliverable address; in that last case HarvestAPI's profile is kept and only Apollo's address is taken, and Apollo addresses are written only with email_status verified. When the contact had no LinkedIn URL and Apollo's corroborated match carries one, HarvestAPI is asked with that URL (the handoff) and its profile wins; if it finds nothing, Apollo's data stands. Apollo is fuzzy, so its match must be corroborated against the CRM (a shared address, the contact's LinkedIn profile, or the known company domain) before its address, LinkedIn URL or photo is kept; an uncorroborated address is named in the outcome comment and written nowhere. A corroborated work address takes Primary Email when the existing Primary is a consumer mailbox; a corporate Primary is left alone. Enriched names only fill blanks. The Linkedin property is written only when the profile slug actually changes, and a run triggered by this workflow's own write (last edit by the Notion connection's bot within 5 minutes of Last Enriched, not a button press) is skipped, so the Contacts automation on Linkedin edits cannot loop. The profile photo is imported into Notion (file_uploads external_url) and set as the page icon and cover. Empty webhook pings are skipped without raising.
enrichment_note: HarvestAPI (App242893CLIAPI find_profile, since 2026-10-07) is tried first whenever the Linkedin property is set; synchronous, usually 6-25s, one retry when Zapier's 30s action limit kills it (since 2026-10-15); an unknown URL returns an empty data array. Apollo people/match replaced BetterContact as the fallback on 2026-11-03: one synchronous sdk.fetch through the apollo-api API by Zapier connection (master key; verified from the durable sandbox 2026-11-03), reveal_personal_emails and reveal_phone_number off. The native Apollo connection (02be390b, ApolloCLIAPI) authenticates too, but its catalog has no enrichment action (people/match only via the hidden _zap_raw_request), so it is not bound.
